aboutPage.title: Rick's story
aboutPage.paragraph1: My name is Rick and I've been a professional tattoo artist for 12 years. My mission is to turn your ideas, stories, and feelings into high-quality art on skin.
aboutPage.paragraph2: Over the years I've specialized in a few styles to deliver exactly what you're after: black and grey realism, for shadow, depth, and striking detail; minimalism and fine line, for thin, precise, delicate strokes; and old school, with the classic charm of bold lines and presence.
aboutPage.paragraph3: Whether it's a small, delicate piece to mark a memory or a large, exclusive project covering the whole body, expect a warm welcome, strict biosafety, and the highest quality you deserve.

before.q: How do I book an appointment?
before.a: Everything is arranged by Instagram DM, @rickarttattoo_fl. Send your idea, approximate size, and placement — from there we talk through the design and set a date.

before.q: How much does a tattoo cost?
before.a: Every project is quoted individually, based on size, style, level of detail, and session length. There's no fixed price list — send a reference on DM to get a quote.
Yes. The studio is private and works by advance booking only, with a set time, so you get full attention during your session.

before.q: Can I bring someone with me?
before.a: Since the space is private and reserved for one client at a time, it's best to arrange this in advance over DM.
Yes, clients must be 18 or older, with valid ID.

after.q: How do I clean a fresh tattoo?
after.a: Wash the area with lukewarm water and unscented, gentle soap, using a clean hand — never a sponge or loofah. Pat dry with clean paper towel, without rubbing.
Yes. Once dry, apply a thin layer of the ointment or unscented lotion I recommend, 2 to 3 times a day, through the first few weeks of healing.

after.q: Can I go to the beach, pool, or sun?
after.a: Avoid direct sun, the ocean, pools, and baths until the skin is fully healed — usually 2 to 4 weeks, depending on size and placement.
Yes, that's part of healing. Don't pick at scabs or scratch the area — it can pull out ink and affect the final result.

after.q: How long until it's fully healed?
after.a: Skin usually looks healed within 2 to 3 weeks, but full healing in the deeper layers takes 4 to 6 weeks. Message me on DM with any questions during that time.
